answer: Put availability bond forfeited on failed retrieval audit at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 454 aliases would need 454 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The island test is the live device, the zephyr test is the locked stake, and the sparrow test is the graded history no template can fake. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
